name: GNN–ACO Hybrid for Multi-Depot Vehicle Route Optimization
label: Research project
summary: Combining graph learning and swarm intelligence for complex route planning.
detail: A research project exploring a hybrid Graph Neural Network and Ant Colony Optimization approach for multi-depot vehicle route optimization. The work brings learned graph representations together with search-based optimization to investigate more effective routing decisions across multiple depots.
story: The project explores a hybrid approach to the multi-depot vehicle-routing problem, where customers must be assigned and sequenced across more than one starting depot.
Graph Neural Networks offer a way to represent relationships between depots, customers and routes, while Ant Colony Optimization provides a search strategy inspired by collective trail formation.
Bringing the two ideas together creates a framework for investigating route quality, search efficiency and the trade-offs involved in complex distribution networks.
supportAlt: Diagram illustrating a depot and multiple vehicle routes between customers
supportCredit: Vehicle-routing problem diagram · PierreSelim · Public domain

name: Medical Disease Risk Prediction
label: Machine learning project
summary: A machine-learning exploration of diabetes and heart-disease risk indicators using structured health data.
detail: A machine-learning project focused on diabetes and heart-disease risk indicators. The work explores how structured health data can be prepared for interpretable inputs, how predictive approaches can be compared, and how early risk signals can be presented responsibly for review rather than diagnosis.
story: This machine-learning project focuses on risk prediction for diabetes and heart disease using structured health indicators.
The workflow considers how clinical attributes can be prepared for modelling, how predictions should be evaluated, and how results can be communicated without presenting them as a medical diagnosis.
The interface concept brings risk scores, contributing factors and trends into one view, making the output easier to interpret while keeping clinical context central.

note: Medical disease-risk prediction dashboard showing diabetes and heart-disease insights.
